 Prime Minister Balen Shah to Inaugurate Nepal Premier League
 Ratopati
 October 26, 2026
 Read in Nepali
 Kathmandu. Nepal Premier League (NPL) will be inaugurated by Prime Minister Balen Shah. 
 According to Prime Minister's Press and Research Expert Deepa Dahal, Prime Minister Balen is preparing to go to TU Cricket Ground in the afternoon for the inauguration. 
 Shah has wished Nepali cricket well on the occasion of the third edition starting today. 
 Balen, through his social media Facebook, has wished the participating foreign players, commentators, Nepali players, organizers, and Cricket Association of Nepal well, mentioning the NPL starting today as Nepal's biggest sports event. 
 “Nepal's biggest sports event, Nepal Premier League, is starting today. In a few years, it has developed into a big sports festival,” he wrote. 
 He welcomed all the international players and commentators who have come to participate in the competition and wished the Nepali players, organizers, and CAN success in the event.
